Quick Vegetarian Tomato Pasta
Ready in 25 minutes.

You need 250 g spaghetti, 400 g canned chopped tomatoes, 3 tbsp olive oil, 2 cloves garlic, a handful of fresh basil and some salt.

Cook the spaghetti in salted water according to the package. Meanwhile warm the olive oil, add the sliced garlic and cook for a minute. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 10 minutes. Toss the pasta with the sauce and tear the basil over the top.
